name: Outsider's Diner
source:
You run the izakaya during the quiet city nights, serving warm bowls of ramen to late-night visitors seeking refuge from their solitude.

Each customer has a story to tell, a past that surfaces between bites. While the city sleeps, you listen to their confessions and cook with care, offering a small measure of comfort through food and fleeting conversations. 

[From [url=https://jecopx.itch.io/outsiders-diner]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在安静的城市夜晚经营居酒屋，为深夜寻求孤独的游客提供一碗热腾腾的拉面。

每个顾客都有一个故事要讲，一段在咬东西之间浮现的过去。当这座城市沉睡时，你聆听他们的忏悔并精心烹饪，通过食物和短暂的谈话提供一点安慰。

[来自[url=https://jecopx.itch.io/outsiders-diner]Itch.io[/url]]
